label: Custom Product Field
purpose: Add a custom input field for order personalization (engraving, gift message, etc.)
_notes: type picks the input widget; only the placeholder matching that type is relevant (text_placeholder for 'text', number_placeholder for 'number', textarea_placeholder for 'textarea'). select_options/swatch_options are comma-separated lists of choices and only apply when type is 'select'/'swatches' or 'pills'/'swatches' respectively. required disables Add to Cart until the field is filled; atc_error_message shows inside the Add to Cart button and field_error_message shows next to the field when a required value is missing. field_name (the internal order line-item property key) is intentionally excluded — it's a technical identifier, not shopper-facing text. Sizing, swatch color values and layout settings are excluded.
